verdict.rationale: Segment's Unify/Identity Resolution docs explicitly describe merging cross-device, cross-channel, online/offline data (cookie IDs, device IDs, emails, external IDs) into a single profile via an ID graph, with the Profile API and Profile Explorer for inspecting resolved profiles. Configurability is implied through identity resolution rules and external_ids/traits merging, though detailed configuration mechanics (e.g., specific merge-rule precedence, conflict resolution documentation) aren't deeply evidenced. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of identity-resolution accuracy, and more granular documentation of configurable merge rules beyond high-level descriptions.
